test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the word that does NOT belong to the following group.

Aluminium, Copper, Chlorine, Zinc
solution:
**Chlorine is the odd one out.**

The other three terms - Aluminium, Copper, Zinc are metals whereas chlorine is not a metal. So it does not belong to the group.

Hence,** 'option 3**' is the correct answer.
